text:
alex kim: Heads-up — qx3b quant build (4-bit) rolled into canary yesterday and we're seeing weird truncation on long multilingual prompts, esp. zh/ja mixed with english.

maria gonzalez: ugh. observed on which dataset?

alex kim: on the promptbank longctx holdout + a fresh slice of user-simulated dialogs (~4k tokens). failure mode: stops mid-sentence and returns partial JSON blobs.

priya rao: can you paste an example?

alex kim: sure — repro prompt: ```{"user": "我想知道 the best way to... (long combined)"}``` output: ```{"assistant": "...可以试着使用", "extra": "\u0000\u0000"}``` — truncated, nulls appear.

samir patel: looks like kv-cache index overflow or token type handling. qx3b had a custom packing change last week.

labeler-bot: New issue created: ML-1283 — qx3b longctx truncation / null bytes in outputs. Assigned to @alex kim and @samir patel.

natalie chen: Reproduced locally on g4dn-equivalent with quantized weights. Float32 baseline is clean.

maria gonzalez: Immediate ask: is this a model quantization regression or a promptset/data issue? Need to triage for canary rollback.

priya rao: For curation side — we should quarantine any long multilingual prompts from the golden set until we understand. We had a couple of mixed-lang anchors that might have triggered this.

alex kim: Agreed. Can we snapshot the current golden holdout? I want to rerun evals.

samir patel: Snap requested: `sha256:golden-holdout-2026-03-21-qp1` stored to /mnt/eval/snapshots. I'll kick an eval job against qx3b and float baseline.

deploy-bot: Deploy event: qx3b-canary -> started by @samir patel at 2026-03-21T09:12:18Z.

maria gonzalez: Priority: if qx3b fails >5% of longctx multilang samples vs baseline, rollback. Also tag any failing samples with `regression/quant` for labeler review.

priya rao: I'll spin up a quick labeling batch with instructions: "Mark whether output is truncated, malformed JSON, or hallucinated/incorrect content." Add an extra field for language-mix fraction.

labeler-bot: Label batch created: LB-4427 (200 samples) assigned to multilingual annotators. Link: https://labels.internal/review/LB-4427

alex kim: Early eval numbers: qx3b truncated 12/200, float baseline 0/200. BLEU/ROUGE drop obvious on mixed-lang slots.

samir patel: Ok that's >5%. I'm going to roll back canary and open a deeper debug. Rolling back now.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: qx3b-canary -> previous: float-verified at 2026-03-21T09:37:04Z.

natalie chen: For curation: we need better sampling for these mixed-lang long prompts. Current sampler underweights long multilingual combos. I propose a focused augment: +10k synthetic mixes (zh/en, ja/en) and run dedupe with the new fuzzy-hash v2.

priya rao: Agree. Also update labeler guide: show examples of benign truncation (cut by client) vs model-caused truncation (mid-token nulls or broken JSON). That will reduce noisy labels.

maria gonzalez: After rollback, next steps: 1) triage quant packing change, 2) expand golden holdout with targeted mixed-lang longctx samples, 3) run deterministic evals + add regression alert to CI for this slice.

alex kim: I've started a small repro harness: `scripts/repro/longctx_multilang.sh` with seeds and tokenizer flags. Putting it in PR so team can run locally.

samir patel: Sharing kernel logs and kv-cache stats in the issue. Also suspect token-type table mismatch in quant routine.

priya rao: For dataset ops: I'll create a temporary quarantine branch of promptbank and tag samples that fail the labeler as `quarantine/quant-longctx`. We should not delete them — need them for debugging.

labeler-bot: LB-4427 initial labels: 200 processed -> 18 flagged as truncated, 7 ambiguous.

maria gonzalez: Good. Once we have gold labels, we can add those failing samples as a regression suite to the eval harness (so future quant builds can't regress silently).

alex kim: Filing follow-up tasks: ML-1284 (quant packing revert + tests), ML-1285 (add longctx-multilang regression to smoke), DS-991 (augment promptbank + dedupe run).

natalie chen: I'll schedule a curation sync tomorrow, include annotators & model infra. We need to align labeling rules and the sampler weight changes.

samir patel: Thanks. If anyone finds other weird encodings (nul bytes, surrogate pairs), drop them into ML-1283 logs.

priya rao: ping @maria gonzalez and @alex kim — can you confirm which annotators should be prioritized for LB-4427? Prefer people who speak zh/ja + english.

maria gonzalez: @priya rao yes — assign to the multilingual cohort (team: intl-annotators).

alex kim: Thx. I'll follow up with a short summary for the release notes: "qx3b canary pulled due to long-context multilingual truncation — root cause under investigation." :warning:

priya rao: Great. Closing loop: quarantine, label, snapshot, rollback, defer qx3b until fixed.

labeler-bot: Noted: LB-4427 -> 200 items, tags added: `regression/quant`, `quarantine/longctx`.
